request: User inspected /games/rts/models/ close-ups: weapons/shields far cruder than bodies, buildings low-poly and blurry. Polish pass.
source_mode: codex builtin image_gen original material sources + existing original generated building sources; parametric code-primitive geometry (art-factory/rts/tools/model_polish_weapons.py, model_polish_buildings.py); no third-party meshes, textures or motion

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Opaque tiling PBR material scans on authored meshes; chroma-key and alpha cleanup are inapplicable.

postprocess.materials: mirror: centred half crop -> LANCZOS 512 -> mirror 2x2 = 1024 colour JPEG q90; crossfade: LANCZOS 1024 + 20 px opposite-edge crossfade; 512 OpenGL normal and metal/roughness maps derived from luminance (detail_materials.normal_map). No painting, inpainting, added noise or text.
postprocess.equipment: New rigid piece measured from the published one (axis, grip centre, per-material spans) so grip location, hand bone and both LODs stay aligned; vertices weighted 1.0 to the same joint; conservative bounds enlarged if reach grows.
postprocess.buildings: Relief (plinth, buttresses, string courses, corbel table, surrounds) merged into the existing stage-1 LightCutStone primitive: no new nodes, materials or draw calls; materials repointed to polish-v1 maps.

invariants: skeleton, skins, inverse bind matrices and all animation channels byte-identical
body meshes and team masks unchanged
construction stages and part ids unchanged

limits.draw_calls: no increase on buildings; units +0..1 per weapon

qa_gates: weapon geometry winding / NaN / budget tests (model_polish_weapons_test.py)
GLB reload in the real viewer and game
before/after close-ups front, side, game view
publication_scope: local branch feat/browser-rts-model-polish only; not merged, not deployed

hands.request: User inspected close-ups: many hands are bad (很多的手部都不行). Audit every humanoid hand in every clip and rebuild.
hands.source_mode: parametric code-primitive geometry only (art-factory/rts/tools/model_hands_geometry.py, model_hands_build.py) measured from the published meshes in the Idle pose; canonical hand previewed with Blender 5.2 (model_hands_preview_blender.py, -t 2); no imported, sampled or third-party mesh; no new texture (shared polish-v1 equipment atlas)
hands.rig: skeletons have no finger bones: fingers modelled in a fixed per-hand pose (closed grip on the measured handle, relaxed / open / fist for empty hands), rigid on the Hand bone; glove cuffs blend <= 0.35 to the Forearm, steel cuffs rigid
edits: hand / gauntlet meshes replaced in place (same node names, one PolishEquipment primitive)
bare TripoSR hand triangles past the wrist removed from the body
shields: new leather grip on two brackets at the closed hand, shield translated onto it, old floating strap loops removed
over-thick axe hafts slimmed only inside the hand (smooth waist)
invariants: skeleton nodes, skins, inverse bind matrices and every animation channel byte-identical (qa/invariants.json)
qa_gates: qa/clearance.json body clearance + wrist stretch vs baseline, all clips but Death
before/after close-ups per model and key frame
hands.publication_scope: local branch feat/browser-rts-model-polish only; not merged, not deployed
